A hard insurance market occurs when insurers reduce their capacity to take on risk, often leading to higher premiums, stricter underwriting,
and fewer policy options. This can make it harder and more expensive for businesses to secure cover. During a hard market, working with
an experienced insurance broker like Complete Insurance Advisors helps you access competitive terms, understand policy changes, and
find the right protection despite market pressures.
